function t1.value34()
    local g117
    local g122
    local v123
    for _, child in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        local v110 = child
        local v111 = v110:IsA("Folder")

        if not v111 then
            v111 = v110:IsA("Model")
        end

        if v111 then
            local v112 = v110.Name:lower()
            local v113 = v110.Name == "Characters"

            if not v113 then
                v113 = v110.Name == "Titans"

                if not v113 then
                    v113 = v110.Name == "Terrain"

                    if not v113 then
                        v113 = v110.Name == "Camera"

                        if not v113 then
                            v113 = v110:FindFirstChild("GasTanks", true)

                            if not v113 then
                                v113 = v110:FindFirstChild("Refill", true)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if v113 then
                for _, descendant in pairs(v110:GetDescendants()) do
                    local v116 = descendant:IsA("BasePart")

                    if not v116 then
                        v116 = descendant:IsA("Model")
                    end

                    if v116 then
                        t1.value33(descendant)
                    end
                end

                g117 = true
            end

            if not g117 then
                local v118 = false
                local v119, v120, v121 = ipairs({
					"tree",
					"leaves",
					"house",
					"building",
					"rock",
					"stone",
					"prop",
					"fence",
					"bush",
					"unclimbable"
				})

                repeat
                    repeat
                        if not g122 then
                            v121, v123 = v119(v120, v121)
                        end

                        if g122 or not v121 then
                            g122 = false

                            if v118 then
                                pcall(function()
                                    v110:Destroy()
                                end)
                            else
                                for _, descendant in pairs(v110:GetDescendants()) do
                                    local v126 = descendant:IsA("BasePart")

                                    if not v126 then
                                        v126 = descendant:IsA("Model")
                                    end

                                    if v126 then
                                        t1.value33(descendant)
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            g117 = true
                        end

                    if g117 then
                        break
                    end

                    v118 = true
                    g122 = true
                until not g122
            end
        end

        g117 = false
    end
end

function t1.value43()
    local v141
    local n5 = 1e999
    local Character = t1.value40.Character
    local v144 = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not v144 then
        return nil
    end
    local Titans = workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans")
    if not Titans then
        return nil
    end
    local GetChildren = Titans.GetChildren
    for _, v in pairs(GetChildren(Titans)) do
        local Humanoid = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            local Hitboxes = v:FindFirstChild("Hitboxes")

            if Hitboxes then
                Hitboxes = Hitboxes:FindFirstChild("Hit")
            end

            local v151 = Hitboxes and Hitboxes:FindFirstChild("Nape")

            if v151 then
                local Magnitude = (v144.Position - v151.Position).Magnitude

                if Magnitude < n5 then
                    v141 = v
                    n5 = Magnitude
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return v141
end

    end

function t1.value47()

    local v179 = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        for _, descendant in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant.Name == "GasTanks" and descendant:IsA("Model") then

                    PrimaryPart = descendant:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                end

                if PrimaryPart then
                    local Magnitude = (v179.Position - PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude

                    if Magnitude < n6 then
                        n6 = Magnitude
                        v176 = PrimaryPart
                    end
                end
            end

    end

    return v176
end

                    local PlayerGui = t1.value40:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")

                    if PlayerGui then
                        local Interface = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Interface")

                        if Interface then
                            Interface = PlayerGui.Interface:FindFirstChild("HUD")

                            if Interface then
                                Interface = PlayerGui.Interface.HUD:FindFirstChild("Main")
                            end
                        end

                        PlayerGui = Interface
                    end

                    if PlayerGui then
                        local Top = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Top")

                        if Top then
                            Top = PlayerGui.Top:FindFirstChild("7")

                            if Top then
                                Top = PlayerGui.Top["7"]:FindFirstChild("Blades")
                            end
                        end

                        PlayerGui = Top
                    end

                    local n7 = 0

                    if PlayerGui and PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Sets") then
                        n7 = tonumber(string.match(PlayerGui.Sets.Text, "%d+")) or 0
                    end

                    local v262 = n7 > 0
                    local v263 = Character:FindFirstChild("Rig_" .. t1.value40.Name)

                    if not v263 then
                        v263 = Character:FindFirstChild("Rig")

                        if not v263 then
                            v263 = Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
                        end
                    end

                    local v265

                    if v263 then
                        local v264 = v263:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or v263:FindFirstChild("LeftHand")

                        if v264 then
                            v264 = v264:FindFirstChild("Blade_1")
                        end

                        v265 = not v264 or v264.Transparency >= 0.9
                    else
                        v265 = true
                    end

                    if v265 and v262 then
                        t1.value38:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.R, false, game)
                        task.wait(0.05)
                        t1.value38:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.R, false, game)
                        task.wait(1.5)

                        return
                    end

                    if v265 and not v262 then
                        local v266 = t1.value47()

                        if v266 then
                            t1.value46 = true
                            t1.value22 = false

                            local v267 = v266.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                            local timestamp = tick()

                            while (v186.Position - v267).Magnitude > 4 and not (tick() - timestamp > 45) do
                                t1.value37.RenderStepped:Wait()

                                for _, descendant in pairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
                                    if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                                        descendant.CanCollide = false
                                    end
                                end

                                v186.Velocity = (v267 - v186.Position).Unit * t1.value26
                                v186.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(v186.Position, v267)
                            end

                            local u271 = true

                            task.spawn(function()
                                while u271 do
                                    t1.value37.RenderStepped:Wait()

                                    if v186 then
                                        v186.Velocity = Vector3.zero
                                        v186.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(v267, v267 + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0))
                                    end
                                end
                            end)
                            task.wait(0.5)

                            local ProximityPrompt = v266:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")

                            if not ProximityPrompt then
                                ProximityPrompt = v266.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")

                                if not ProximityPrompt then
                                    ProximityPrompt = v266.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
                                end
                            end

                            if ProximityPrompt then
                                fireproximityprompt(ProximityPrompt)
                            end

                            t1.value38:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.R, false, game)
                            task.wait(0.05)
                            t1.value38:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.R, false, game)
                            task.wait(3.5)
                            u271 = false
                            t1.value46 = false
                            t1.value22 = true
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end)
t1.value37.Stepped:Connect(function()
    local Character = t1.value40.Character

    if Character and t1.value22 then
        local GetDescendants = Character.GetDescendants

        for _, v in pairs(GetDescendants(Character)) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.CanCollide then
                v.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
end)

local AutoRetry = t1.value14.AutoRetry
local AutoLeave = t1.value14.AutoLeave
t1.value48 = {
	Retry = AutoRetry,
	Leave = AutoLeave
}
task.spawn(function()
    game:GetService("GuiService")
    game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

    local n8 = 0

    while task.wait(1.5) do
        pcall(function()
            local v273 = not t1.value48.Retry
            local g284
            if v273 then
                v273 = not t1.value48.Leave
            end
            if v273 then
                return
            end
            local PlayerGui = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
            local Interface = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Interface")
            if Interface then
                Interface = PlayerGui.Interface:FindFirstChild("Rewards")
            end
            if not Interface then
                return
            end
            if Interface:IsA("GuiObject") and not Interface.Visible then
                return
            end
            local Main = Interface:FindFirstChild("Main")
            if Main and not Main.Visible then
                return
            end
            if tick() - n8 < 30 then
                return
            end
            local Retry = t1.value48.Retry
            local u278
            local GetDescendants = Interface.GetDescendants
            local v280, v281, v282 = pairs(GetDescendants(Interface))
            local v283
            repeat
                repeat
                    repeat
                        repeat
                            v282, v283 = v280(v281, v282)

                            if not v282 then
                                g284 = true
                            end

                            if g284 then
                                break
                            end

                            local v285 = v283:IsA("TextLabel") or v283:IsA("TextButton")

                            if v285 then
                                v285 = v283.Visible

                                if v285 then
                                    v285 = v283.Text ~= ""
                                end
                            end
                        until v285

                        if g284 then
                            break
                        end

                        local v286 = v283.Text:upper()
                        local v287 = false

                        if Retry then
                            local v288 = v286:find("RETRY")

                            if not v288 then
                                v288 = v286:find("ลองใหม่")
                            end

                            if v288 then
                                v287 = true
                            end
                        else
                            local v289 = v286:find("LEAVE")

                            if not v289 then
                                v289 = v286:find("LOBBY")

                                if not v289 then
                                    v289 = v286:find("RETURN")

                                    if not v289 then
                                        v289 = v286:find("EXIT") or v286:find("ออกไป")
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            if v289 then
                                v287 = true
                            end
                        end
                    until v287

                    if g284 then
                        break
                    end

                    while true do
                        local v290 = v283

                        if v283 then
                            v290 = not v283:IsA("GuiButton")
                        end

                        if not v290 then
                            break
                        end

                        v283 = v283.Parent
                    end
                until v283 and v283:IsA("GuiButton")

                if g284 then
                    break
                end

                local v291 = v283.AbsolutePosition.X > 0

                if v291 then
                    v291 = v283.AbsolutePosition.Y > 0
                end
            until v291
            if not g284 then
                u278 = v283
            end
            if u278 then
                pcall(function()
                    if t1.value10 then
                        t1.value10:Notify({
							Title = "Auto End-Game",
							Content = "Target Button Identified. Attempting to click...",
							Duration = 3
						})
                    end
                end)
                n8 = tick()
                task.wait(0.5)
                pcall(function()
                    local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
                    local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

                    GuiService.SelectedObject = u278
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Return, false, game)
                    VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Return, false, game)
                end)
                task.wait(0.1)
                pcall(function()
                    local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
                    local AbsolutePosition = u278.AbsolutePosition
                    local AbsoluteSize = u278.AbsoluteSize
                    local v322 = AbsolutePosition.X + AbsoluteSize.X / 2
                    local v323 = AbsolutePosition.Y + AbsoluteSize.Y / 2 + 36

                    if v322 > 0 and v323 > 0 then
                        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(v322, v323, 0, true, game, 1)
                        task.wait(0.05)
                        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(v322, v323, 0, false, game, 1)
                        task.wait(0.1)

                        local _game = game

                        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(v322, v323 - 36, 0, true, _game, 1)
                        task.wait(0.05)
                        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(v322, v323 - 36, 0, false, game, 1)
                    end
                end)
                task.wait(0.1)
                pcall(function()
                    if getconnections then

                        for v327, v328 in pairs(getconnections(u278.MouseButton1Click)) do

                            v328:Fire()
                        end
                        for _, v in pairs(getconnections(u278.Activated)) do
                            v:Fire()
                        end
                    end

                    if firesignal then
                        firesignal(u278.MouseButton1Click)
                        firesignal(u278.Activated)
                    end
                end)
                task.wait(5)
            end
        end)
    end
end)
t1.value10:CreateTabHeader("End Game Management")

    t1.value48.Retry = p48
    t1.value14.AutoRetry = p48

    if p48 then
        t1.value48.Leave = false
        t1.value14.AutoLeave = false
    end

    t1.value31()
end)
v30:CreateToggle("Auto Leave to Lobby", t1.value14.AutoLeave, function(p49)
    t1.value48.Leave = p49
    t1.value14.AutoLeave = p49

    if p49 then
        t1.value48.Retry = false
        t1.value14.AutoRetry = false
    end

    t1.value31()
end)

		Duration = 3
	})

v29:CreateSection("Global UI Settings"):CreateInput("Toggle UI Keybind", t1.value14.ToggleKey, function(p54)
    if p54 and p54 ~= "" then
        local str = tostring(p54)
        local u200 = false

        pcall(function()
            if Enum.KeyCode[str] then
                u200 = true
            end
        end)

        if u200 then
            t1.value14.ToggleKey = str
            t1.value31()

            local value10 = t1.value10
            local v202 = "UI toggle keybind changed to: " .. str

            value10:Notify({
				Title = "UI Config",
				Content = v202,
				Duration = 3
			})
        else
            local value10 = t1.value10
            local Notify = value10.Notify
            local v205 = "Invalid key '" .. str .. "'. Try LeftControl, RightShift, F1, etc."

            Notify(value10, {
				Title = "UI Config Error",
				Content = v205,
				Duration = 5
			})
        end
    end
end)
